ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the metered RydeTAXI fare (no refund); annotate the trip as rider-consented reroute under RD-5; keep driver statement for record. No account flag.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment departing the quoted route at the PIE eastbound near Bedok North and looping via Paya Lebar / Sims Avenue, adding roughly 3–4 km. Exempt under RD-5: the driver proposed the reroute by chat at 12:24:05 and the rider expressly agreed at 12:24:45, before the trajectory actually left the optimal route (GPS still on the PIE alignment at 12:24:10 and only deviating from 12:25:10), and the named alternative (Sims Avenue) matches the segment taken; RD-4 does not independently exempt it (no traffic incidents; only band-4 speed bands on PIE/CTE, band 1–2 required by RD-4(b)).

rejected_claims.reason: Rider claims overcharge from a longer route. On a metered RydeTAXI, extra distance enters the meter, but the deviation was expressly agreed by the rider before it occurred (chat 12:24:05 / 12:24:45; GPS confirms divergence only after consent), so under RD-5 it is not an unexempted detour and no extra-km refund is owed (RD-2: refundable amount = $0.00).
